usedFor: Ebby manages real estate transactions, and HubSpot receives each one as a deal through “New File Created” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New File Created” in Ebby, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new transaction file becomes a deal in HubSpot, so sales sees it without retyping.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a file with no email on it cannot make a HubSpot contact.
